abstract: Estimates depot structural modifications, civil groundworks, and foundation outlays
system_message:
You are the Civil infrastructure engineer (CIV), responsible for estimating depot structural modifications, civil groundworks, and foundation outlays, as well as evaluating subsurface drainage resilience for municipal transit fleet electrification schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Subsurface drainage resilience（SOIL）
information_points.content:
CIV-SOIL-OVH：The Opportunity pantograph rapid charging scheme exhibits a stormwater retention runoff coefficient of 0.65 1 across its paved maintenance yard and charging pads.
CIV-SOIL-V9S：According to the depot hydraulic assessment for the paved maintenance yard and charging pads, the Overnight depot plug-in charging scheme has a stormwater retention runoff coefficient of 0.35 1.
CIV-SOIL-Q6N：Based on the depot hydraulic evaluation of the paved maintenance yard and charging areas, the Automated battery swap terminal scheme features a stormwater retention runoff coefficient of 0.5 1.

information_points.title: Estimates depot structural modifications, civil groundworks, and foundation outlays（YARD）
information_points.content:
CIV-YARD-ZNZ：For the Opportunity pantograph rapid charging scheme, the depot civil works cost per vehicle is 22 kGBP/bus, based on yard structural foundations, conduits, and gantry modifications per allocated bus.
CIV-YARD-9O2：For the Automated battery swap terminal scheme, the depot civil works cost per vehicle is 34 kGBP/bus, covering yard structural foundations, conduits, and gantry installations across the allocated bus fleet.
CIV-YARD-NUC：For the Overnight depot plug-in charging scheme, the depot civil works cost per vehicle is 22 kGBP/bus, covering yard structural foundations, conduits, and gantry works calculated across the allocated bus fleet.
